title: Contrast enhanced imaging through weakly scattering media with spatially entangled photons
summary: Improving the image contrast of objects immersed in weakly scattering media can be achieved using various strategies. One common approach is to reject events associated with scattered photons in favor of the detection of ballistic photons. While this is traditionally done via time gating or spatial filtering, we propose a different approach based on probing the object with spatio-temporally entangled photon pairs.
